Skill 2, Whirling Strike, can help you clear the first minion wave quickly to get level 2 before your opponent, giving you an advantage that you can use to win early trades. Teamfights are a struggle for Arthur. You don't have a lot of mobility, so it's difficult for you to get onto the back line with your Ultimate and Skill 1. Try to stay in bushes to surprise the enemy carries and use your silence to stop high-impact skills on the enemy team. Always stay close enough to your team so they can back up your engage, and don't chase too far, as you can be kited very easily.

## Tips & Tricks
Start trades with Skill 1 for more damage on your auto attacks and other skills
You can auto attack after using Skill 1 to dash anywhere even over walls

Augran has one of the fastest jungle clear speeds in the entire game. With Skill 1 Path of Passing, he can walk through terrain and execute jungle camps with his auto attacks. In teamfights, positioning is key. You want to be close enough so you can auto attack and execute enemies, but you also don't want to be too close that you can be burst down from the enemies' crowd control. Save your Ultimate Conductor of Soul for the right moment. You don't need to always use it at the start of a fight. Sometimes you need to save it for the heal or use it to be able to get Steer State to execute low-health enemies.

Only use Skill 1 a 2nd time to enter Steer State when you can execute enemies or jungle camps
If you want to quickly enter Steer State to execute enemies, use your Ultimate

hokfire_guide.gameplay_tips:
## Early Game
For most of the Early Game, Chicha will be in melee form, which is her weakest state. You can use minions or jungle monsters to get 4 stacks of your passive, so once you go to the lane, you only need to auto-attack once, then use Skill 2 World-Splitting Spear to deal huge poke damage. Most of the Early Game will be you sitting underneath the tower last hitting minions, and waiting for your Overkill Form before looking to trade.

## Teamfights
Before entering a teamfight, make sure to attack jungle monsters or minions to get 4 stacks. This is essential to Chicha's playstyle since her Overkill Form is what will win teamfights. Be patient with your Ultimate Return of the Armsmaster; wait for the right moment and target before using it for huge damage. You can use Skill 1 and Skill 2 during your Ultimate to help gap close and finish off enemies.

## Tips & Tricks
Attack monsters or minions 4 times before joining a fight so you can enter Overkill Form straight away for maximum damage
Use Skill 1 and Skill 2 before entering Overkill Form since the cooldown gets reduced
Always use Skill 2 as soon as you enter Overkill since it has a long cooldown
Make sure to use the attack button when using your Ultimate to deal damage

Da Qiao rewards good map awareness over mechanics. The hardest part is choosing the right moment to portal - when in doubt, use it to save rather than to gamble on a risky engage.

## Key Combos
- Ultimate to teleport your team into a gank, then Skill 1 to heal during the fight.
- Ultimate defensively to pull a diving ally out of a lost fight.

## Early Game
Focus on farming and last-hitting minions to maximise the amount of gold you get. In teamfights, always keep an eye on your positioning. Stay behind your team so you don't get jumped on by assassins. When using Flowborn marksman Ultimate, you will be a little exposed, so be sure to use it in a safe position. Save Skill 2 to reposition, whether that's away from the enemy to escape or close the gap to help you finish off low-health enemy heroes.

## Tips & Tricks
In base Passive: Early Game > Damage ; Late Game > Movement Speed
Use Ultimate twice to levitate over walls
Skill 2 can be used to help last-hit minions or for mobility in fights

## Early Game
For the first minion wave, you can use Skill 1 Arcane Assault and aim it so it hits all the minions. ## Teamfights
Kongming can be very challenging to play in teamfights. He's not your traditional mid lane mage that sits back and uses abilities from range; he wants to get in the face of enemies utilising his passive and burst damage. You want to keep yourself alive and look to cleanup fights when heroes are low on health. If you can use his Ultimate Winning Strategy to finish off heroes, you can use it multiple times in a teamfight. However, one misposition or one wrong dash and you could get caught and one-shot since Kongming is very squishy.

## Tips & Tricks
Position and use Skill 1 where you can hit all 3 orbs to get maximum stacks for his Passive
Never use Kongming's Ultimate at the start of a fight
Use minions and monsters to get stacks for your passive before joining a teamfight

hokfire_guide.gameplay_tips:
## Early Game
Luara's early game is very weak. With her low attack range, it's extremely difficult to walk up and try to trade efficiently, so most of the time you want to stay underneath the tower and farm safely. Start with Skill 2 to safely farm from range and try to poke the enemy at the same time. Skill 1 can help you clear minion waves and gives you extra movement speed to run out of the enemy Marksman's attack range and escape ganks.

## Teamfights
With Luara's low range, it's always best to attack the first enemy in front of you. Always fight around terrain so you can use your Skill 1 to jump over walls to escape danger. Your Ultimate Blazing Glare is a game changer. It does insane damage, and blinding is a very strong tool to have, where enemies' attacks and skills will miss you. It's best to save this for when you get dove on by assassins

## Tips & Tricks
In fights, stay near a wall so you can use Skill 1 to jump over and escape
Use Skill 1 before Skill 2 to get a serpent blade that does damage when Skill 2 hits

## Early Game
Start in the mid lane and use Skill 2 to poke the enemy and help your mid laner push the minion wave with your passive. Skill 2 is a strong tool to have early on with its long range and CC potential. If you find yourself in any danger, use Skill 1 to dash away to safety.

## Teamfights
In teamfights, you want to continue to use Skill 2 at range to CC the enemy and try to catch isolated targets. You don't want to be the first one to dive in with your Ultimate. Instead, wait for your frontline to dive in first and then follow up with Think Inside the Box to lockdown the enemy. You need to be flexible with your playstyle, as in some instances you need to protect your carries and instead use your Skill 2 and Ultimate to peel for them.

You can auto-attack and stack Mozi's passive whilst walking around to get your 4th empowered attack at any time
Use Skill 1 to reposition in fights for your Skill 2 or Ultimate

Wang Zhaojun has a pretty solid early game. Her wave clear isn't the best early on, but when you rotate, your crowd control can be clutch in skirmishes. Don't waste Frigid Prison Skill 2 for poke. Instead, keep it for setting up kills and punishing enemies who step too far forward.

In teamfights, be patient with Frigid Prison Skill 2 and only use it when you can guarantee it hits an enemy. Position yourself in the back line and use your Ultimate Winter is Here to protect yourself and zone enemies.

You can auto-attack whilst standing still to get your enhanced basic attack when you get to lane or at the start of a fight
Use Skill 1 Shattered Ice to slow enemies, making Skill 2 Frigid Prison easier to hit
You can use Skill 1 and Skill 2 to check bushes before enterting them

hokfire_guide.gameplay_tips:
## Early Game
Wukong has decent early jungle clear speed with his Skill 2 mobility and empowered auto attacks. He also has a lot of burst damage early on, and great crowd control with his Ultimate Golden Cudgel, so you can look for early ganks to try and snowball the early game; however, if you make a mistake and fall behind, it becomes extremely difficult to come back into the game.

## Teamfights
In teamfights, as an assassin, Wukong wants to hide in bushes and engage from unexpected angles. You don't want to be the first one to engage in the front line. You need to completely ignore the tanks and focus on their Marksman or Mage to one-shot them with your burst combo. This is your main goal; failing to do so will lose you the teamfight and potentially the game.

## Tips & Tricks
Always basic attack after using a Skill to deal bonus damage with Wukong's passive
Save Skill 1 for blocking important enemy skills
You can use Skill 2 to bounce off minions or teammates to help escape or catch up to enemies
